title: Valentine’s Day
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this Valentine's Day episode, office members share their feelings and experiences related to the holiday, including Pam receiving flowers, Jim planning to play cards alone, and romantic tensions involving Michael, Jan, and others. The episode also features humorous exchanges about gifts, relationships, and office dynamics, culminating in Jan's distress over rumors about her and Michael.

main_threads.thread: Office Valentine's Day celebrations and personal relationships

evidence.snippet: Pam: I really like Valentine's Day in this office. It's kinda like grade school. Everybody gives out little presents and stuff.
Pam (Delivery man enters with a bouquet of red roses. Pam stands up to look at card.): Phyllis.
Pam: Roy and I are saving for the wedding, so I made him promise not to get me anything too big.
Meredith: "Happy Valentine's Day darling. Love Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration."
Phyllis: Isn't he sweet?
Kelly: So I said, "Ryan, what took you so long?" And I just said that to him, can you believe that?

main_threads.thread: Michael's interactions with Jan and office conflicts

evidence.snippet: Michael: This is a business trip. I would have to be a raving lunatic to try to talk to Jan about what happened between us.
Michael: Maybe because she's my girlfriend. Was, or not my girlfriend. She's… we hooked up and…
Michael: You know, months ago, just once, It's, just stupid. Just forget it,
Jan: NO, NO I'm not, I'm not, I just… I just don't know what to do anymore, Michael. I mean, we're all gonna get fired.
Jan: Yeah, Michael – the CFO thinks that we slept together. Do you understand, people get fired for much less?
Michael: I know. It was borderline at best and… And Jan is a fantastic executive and has all the integrity in the world and um, I'm really sorry.
